headline: Tiger Shroff in car, 5 shots fired, then 3 men flee on bike: New video of attack bid surfaces
caption:
Tiger Shroff firing video aaya saamne 🚨
Video mein do hamlawar Tiger ki car par goli chalate dikhte hain, phir teesre aadmi ke saath bike par bhaag jaate hain.
Tiger ko minor abrasions aaye, driver Firdos ke haath mein goli lagi. Do kathit Bishnoi gang operatives ne zimmedari li hai, police ki 15 teams talaash mein.
Aapke hisaab se Bollywood stars ki security aur tight honi chahiye? Haan ya Na? Comment karo 👇
